newsitem.title: CANADA: Poco to bid C$225 mln for Gardiner.
newsitem.headline: Poco to bid C$225 mln for Gardiner.

text.p: Poco Petroleums Ltd said on Wednesday it would make a takeover bid worth about C$225 million for Gardiner Oil & Gas Ltd.
Poco said it would offer Gardiner holders C$5 cash and 0.6 of a Poco common share for every Gardiner share held.
Poco entered into lock-up deals with shareholders of Gardiner who own or control about 13 million common shares or about 73 percent of the Gardiner stock.
These holders agreed to deposit their shares under the bid unless a third party offer materialized for all of Gardiner at a cash price of not less than C$13.50 a share.
The offer is subject to appropriate regulatory approvals and to a minimum of 90 percent of Gardiner shares being tendered to the offer.
Poco will mail a takeover bid circular to all Gardiner shareholders.

Gardiner's proven and probably reserves consist of 12 million barrels of crude oil and natural gas liquids and 200 billion cubic feet of natural gas. Gardiner also has 250,000 net acres of undeveloped land.
